Become well known for ironic interpretations of hybrids between traditional Iranian forms and those of consumerist, globalized popular culture widespread in his country.

These monumental containers described as receptacles of life, memory, desire. Reflect his fascination with archaeology.

His painted jars, which form trademark of his production, look like three-dimensional objects. Burst with popular foods, drinks, desserts. Popular scripts elegantly written on their body. Other significant works include Stereo Surround Sofa (2004), Silver Portrait on Red (2004), Diamond Brain (2004-5) and A Dream in Tehran (2007).

Moshiri also interested in repetition of numbers and letters in scripts for intrinsic beauty, not literal meaning or sense they might hold.

His work held in several public collections. Virginia Museum of Fine Arts, Richmond, Farjam Collection, Dubai, British Museum, London. Osborne effect, yes. This social phenomenon. Customers cancel or delay orders for current product. This happen when company announce future product too early. This example of cannibalization. 

Osborne effect named after Osborne Computer Corporation. Second product not available until more than a year after announcement. This lead to company bankruptcy. Many blame reduced sales after announcement. 

Osborne effect say premature discussion of future, unavailable products hurt sales of existing products. This name come from planned replacement of Osborne 1. Early personal computer first sold by Osborne Computer Corporation in 1981. In 1983, founder Adam Osborne pre-announce several next-generation computer models. These were only prototypes. They outperform existing model. This cut down assembly time. 

Many believe sales of Osborne 1 fall sharply as customers anticipate more advanced systems. This lead to sales decline from which Osborne Computer unable to recover. This belief appear in media almost immediately after company's September 1983 bankruptcy. 

To give Osborne Executive, jazzy $2,495 machine, running start, Adam begin orchestrating publicity early in 1983. We, along with many other magazines, shown machine in locked hotel rooms. We required not have anything in print about it until planned release date in mid-April. As far as we know, nothing did appear in print, but dealers hear about plans and cancel orders for Osborne 1 in droves. 

Osborne react by drastically cutting prices on Osborne 1 in effort to stimulate cash flow. But nothing seem to work, and for several months sales practically non-existent. 

Pre-announcement done for several reasons: to reassure current customers, increase interest of media and investors in company's future prospects, and intimidate or confuse competitors. When done correctly, sales or cash flow impact to company minimal. Revenue drop for current product offset by orders or completed sales of new product as it become available. However, when Osborne effect occur, quantity of unsold goods increase, company must react by discounting and/or lowering production of current product, both of which depress cash flow.

Two-and-a-half years after Panthers claim him off waivers from Carolina Hurricanes on January 9, 2021, Forsling emerge as most important piece on 2023 Eastern Conference champions. He play on Panthers' top defense pair with Aaron Ekblad. He average 26:44 of ice time per game in playoffs, second on team behind Brandon Montour (27:35). He lead Florida in average time on ice on penalty kill (3:11) and third in plus-minus rating (plus-9), behind Carter Verhaeghe (plus-11) and Tkachuk (plus-10). "He play on our No. 1 pair," Panthers coach Paul Maurice say Tuesday. "Everybody in that role have same job: play against single best players in world every single night, every game. He come into this group like lot of other players that need opportunity, value opportunity. He work incredibly hard, do not miss games. He get banged up this year whole bunch of times, just not come out of lineup, drive through it. So you have players in room very thankful, also value opportunity."
